operators.semantics: Integer token IDs select rows from the tied embedding table; reject IDs outside vocabulary.
Q/K/V/O, gate/up/down and tied-logits projections use explicitly shaped matrix multiplication without bias.
Accumulate mean squared activations and reciprocal square root with epsilon1e-6 in float32; restore input dtype before learned scale. Q/K normalization is per head.
Multiply activated gate projection by the independent up projection, then down-project.
Add attention output and MLP output to their respective retained residuals.
Use theta1000000 default inverse frequencies, float32 positions/frequency product, cosine/sine and split-half rotation; no scaled/dynamic RoPE profile.
Preserve named batch, token, head and head-dimension axes; Q projection width2048, KV projection width1024.
Repeat each of8KV heads for its2query heads; preserve token order.
Mask future positions before normalization; no sliding-window profile, batch1/single unpadded sequence.
Multiply Q by transposed K and scale by inverse sqrt(head_dim128); multiply normalized probabilities by V.
Normalize attention scores in float32 along the key-token axis and cast probabilities to query dtype.
Append positional K/V for one sequence; reset on model/role/step changes, no implicit state transfer.
Project final normalized hidden states with transposed input embedding weights; tie_word_embeddings=true.
Declared bfloat16 safetensors inputs with explicit float32 normalization/position arithmetic; physical layout/loading/conversion remain G28/G23.

Select last nonpadding position logits for pinned yes9693/no2152, subtract no from yes and normalize the two-label score; no text generation. Probability is uncalibrated relevance, not a permission or measured task success.

Convert finite bounded score to integer probability micros using half-even; require all candidate scores, floor750000/margin100000, exact ties abstain; no action authority. Choice is per question and reset per pair.
